svg.title: 5,000 clients, one random entry each
svg.desc: With a per-proof API, every query names a different entry, so every one is a cache miss and a database lookup: 5,000 at the server. With tiles, the 5,000 clients make 24,666 tile requests between them, but there are only 277 distinct tiles, so 277 requests reach the host and the shared cache answers 98.9 percent.

text.tspan: a tile is the same file for every client, so caches work. A proof is different for every query.
shared cache hit rate with tiles: 98.9%. The log serves 277 files of hashes, not 5,000 proofs.
